name: Queen Sahar
source:
The Divine Ruler of Thallum. Queen Sahar is one of the closest friends and allies to the King and Queen of Temporia. She rules her people mercifully, but justly as well. She has also been revolutionary in the rights for femboys within her kingdom. Despite having many suitors from different kingdoms, Sahar has not entertained any of these suitors.

[In game description]
